content.title: Euphoria Season 3 Episode 2 Release Date, Time, Where to Watch
content.text: Jacob Elordi doesn’t have much in common with his volatile character in “Euphoria” — aside from his success with the ladies.The actor rose to fame in 2018 and has dated his fair share of high-profile stars since.From Zendaya to Olivia Jade Giannulli, keep scrolling to learn more about the hunky “Frankenstein” star’s love life.Joey King: 2017- 2018Elordi found himself in his first public romance when he started dating co-star Joey King in 2017. Penske Media via Getty ImagesHowever, the pair (pictured above in May 2018) — who met while filming “The Kissing Booth” — split after one year. Getty Images for NetflixElordi and co-star Joey King fell in love in 2017 while shooting Netflix’s “The Kissing Booth,” in which they played love interests.In a 2018 interview with Bello, King admitted she thought Elordi was “very cute” when they first met and the pair became fast friends before exploring something romantic.“It was such an interesting experience meeting your boyfriend on set because you spend so much time together and become so close so fast,” she explained. “We were spending 17 hours a day together, and all of us would hang out after work and watch movies together and stuff. It was great.”Although the pair called it quits in 2018 after just one year of dating, they went on to film two more movies together and have had nothing but nice things to say about each other in the years since.However, Elordi and King (pictured above in July 2023) seem to still be on good terms. Getty ImagesIn a joint Entertainment Tonight interview in 2020, King explained that she doesn’t feel the need to give people an “explanation” as to why they split — which Eloridi dittoed.The following month, the actress told Howard Stern, “I think it’s a good thing we dated. … I learned the most I’ve ever learned in my life from him. I think that it’s awesome to date someone in your field who gets it, but doing the same exact thing as somebody is tough. It’s really tough.”Cari Flowers: 2019Following his split from King, Elordi was briefly linked to Cari Flowers. cariflowers/InstagramA year after his split from King, Elordi was linked to model Cari Flowers.The pair sparked romance rumors in the summer of 2019 after Flowers tagged the “Wuthering Heights” star in an Instagram photo, insinuating he was the one behind the camera.Additionally, she posted a since-deleted photo dump of her “friends in Australia,” which included a shirtless photo of Elordi as well as a snap of the duo locking lips, per Elite Daily.However, the model deleted any trace of Elordi from her feed less than a month later.Zendaya: 2019- 2020He and “Euphoria” co-star Zendaya (pictured above in June 2019) were romantically linked in 2019. FilmMagicElordi decided to mix business with pleasure once again in 2019 when he started dating “Euphoria” co-star Zendaya. While neither star ever spoke out about their rumored romance, they were photographed vacationing together in Greece in August 2019.That year, the “Dune” star reportedly traveled Down Under to spend Thanksgiving with Elordi and his family.When the pair attended the American Australian Arts Awards in 2020, the actress called Elordi her “best friend.” However, the “Euphoria” co-stars (pictured above in January 2022) have continued to work together and seem to be on great terms. Getty Images for HBOAfter the pair were photographed kissing while out and about in Manhattan, sources told E! News they had been “inseparable” for months.“They … have been making time for each other in between projects,” an insider told the outlet. “Jacob has met Zendaya’s family and everyone adores him. They have a lot of fun together and have a lot in common.”While it’s unclear exactly when the pair called it quits, they appear to still be on good terms and continued to work together on their hit HBO show.Zendaya, notably, is engaged — and rumored to already be married — to her “Spider-Man” co-star Tom Holland.Kaia Gerber: 2020- 2021Elordi’s next major romance was with Kaia Gerber (pictured above in September 2021). FilmMagic,Elordi was first linked to model Kaia Gerber in September 2020 after the pair were seen holding hands in New York City, with the couple’s first public outing just so happening to fall on Zendaya’s birthday.Despite speculation there was “nothing serious” going on between the two, Elordi joined Gerber and her family on vacation later that same month.Soon after, they went Instagram official by showing off their couple’s Halloween costumes: Elvis and Priscilla Presley.The model and the actor (pictured above in September 2021) dated for over a year before calling it quits. Diggzy/Jesal/Shutterstock(Ironically, Gerber started dating “Elvis” actor Austin Butler in December 2021 and Elordi was later cast to play the King of Rock & Roll in “Priscilla.”)Although they rarely spoke out about their romance, the pair were often seen out and about in public and even sharing clothes.In May 2021, Gerber finally opened up about the pair’s sweet relationship.“Being able to be with someone I trust, where we don’t want anything from each other, having a safe, steady relationship like that, has really opened my eyes to the possibilities of love and what it feels like to love without conditions,” Gerber told Vogue. “Lust is touching other people or wanting them, but love is really seeing someone.”Sources told us at the time that Elordi’s split from Gerber (pictured above in November 2022) was “amicable.” Getty Images for A Sense of HomeIn September of that year, she and Elordi made their red carpet debut at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures Opening Gala.Despite their deep connection, the pair called it quits in November 2021.While a source confirmed to Page Six at the time that the twosome were no longer together, they insisted things were “amicable” between the exes. In fact, during an interview with Men’s Health magazine published right after their split, Elordi praised Gerber for “handling herself wonderfully publicly” and teaching him “how to deal” with fame.Olivia Jade Giannulli: 2021- 2025The actor dated Olivia Jade Giannulli (pictured above in September 2023) on and off from 2021 until 2025. AbacaPress / SplashNews.comJust one month after Elordi and Gerber split, the actor jumped into a relationship with Olivia Jade Giannulli.The duo sparked dating speculation after photographers snapped them grabbing coffee together in Los Angeles before driving off in Elordi’s Range Rover.However, sources told Us Weekly at the time that the romance was “casual.”“They both got out of relationships recently so they’re not rushing into anything serious. So far it’s going well and there’s sparks between them.”Although they decided to keep their romance out of the public eye, they were often spotted on walks with their dogs around Los Angeles. Despite briefly breaking up in August 2022, the pair (pictured above in May 2022) rekindled their romance less than a year later — and called it quits for good in 2025. Diggzy/Jesal/ShutterstockThe pair decided to go their separate ways in August 2022, only to rekindle their romance in May 2023. At the time, the twosome was seen getting cozy while out and about in Los Angeles. Then, in June, they were spotted soaking up the sun in a resort town near Portofino, Italy.The duo were hit with breakup reports once again in January 2024; however, sources told Page Six they were still going strong.By October 2025, they were “fully over.”Bianca Finch: March 2023Elordi briefly dated Bianca Finch while on a break with Giannulli in 2023. SplashNews.comDuring Elordi’s time apart from Giannulli, the actor was romantically linked to model Bianca Finch.The pair were seen canoodling at a park in LA. During the picnic, Elordi whipped out his camera to take photos of the red-headed beauty.However, things between the two seemingly fizzled quickly.Kendall Jenner: 2026Kendall Jenner (pictured above in September 2024) and Elordi sparked romance rumors in April 2026 after claims they were “making out” at the Coachella music festival. WWD via Getty ImagesKylie Jenner (pictured above in April 2026) was reportedly their matchmaker months prior. drink818/InstagramReports surfaced in April 2026 that Elordi had been dating Kendall Jenner for months after allegedly being introduced by the model’s sister Kylie Jenner.Kylie, notably, is in a relationship with Timothée Chalamet and was reportedly “around Jacob a lot during Timothée’s award season marathon because Jacob was nominated for ‘Frankenstein’ and Timothee was nominated for ‘Marty Supreme.'”Kendall and Elordi initially sparked social media chatter over claims they were “making out” at Justin Bieber’s weekend one Coachella 2026 afterparty.Reps for the couple did not respond to Page Six’s request for comment at the time.
